steps.prompt: Call emergency services immediately. Snake bites from any unknown snake must be treated as potentially venomous. Time to antivenom is critical.
Keep the person as still as possible. Immobilise the bitten limb at or below heart level. Movement speeds venom spread.
Remove rings, watches, or tight clothing near the bite site in case of swelling. Do NOT apply a tourniquet, cut the wound, suck out venom, or apply ice — these cause harm.
Note the time of the bite and try to remember the snake's appearance (do not try to capture or handle it). Give this information to emergency services.
Monitor the person's breathing, level of consciousness, and the area around the bite for spreading redness or swelling. Stay with them until emergency services arrive.
steps.cta: Keep still and wait for emergency services
